background.zh: 1964 年，他是伦敦富人区肯辛顿（Kensington）同一所私立预备学校里被选中的三个男孩之一。
background.en: In 1964 he was one of three boys filmed at the same private pre-preparatory school in Kensington, a wealthy district of London.

background.zh: 1964 年，他是伦敦肯辛顿同一所私立预备学校里被选中的三个男孩之一。
background.en: In 1964 he was one of three boys filmed at the same private pre-preparatory school in Kensington, London.

f28.zh: 从 28 Up 起不再参与拍摄，起因是与导演 Michael Apted 的矛盾。他后来说，自己被和两个“并不是我朋友”的男孩归为一类，有种被困住的感觉。
f28.en: Stopped taking part from 28 Up, after a clash with director Michael Apted. He later said he had felt typecast alongside two boys who "weren't mates of mine" and trapped in a situation "that wasn't me".

f35.zh: 未参与拍摄（21 Up 之后退出）。
f35.en: Did not take part (left the series after 21 Up).

f42.zh: 未参与拍摄（21 Up 之后退出）。
f42.en: Did not take part (left the series after 21 Up).

f49.zh: 未参与拍摄（21 Up 之后退出）。
f49.en: Did not take part (left the series after 21 Up).

f56.zh: 未参与拍摄（21 Up 之后退出）。
f56.en: Did not take part (left the series after 21 Up).

f63.zh: 未参与拍摄。据维基百科，片中关于他的内容几乎全部删去，只在与 Andrew、John 的合影旧镜头里一闪而过。
f63.en: Did not take part. According to Wikipedia, references to him were removed except for fleeting archive shots alongside Andrew and John.

f70.zh: 没有出镜：只提供了画外音评论，片中只用了几张他的照片，脸部被刻意遮挡。
f70.en: Did not appear on camera: he contributed voiceover commentary and is seen only in photographs with his face deliberately obscured.

background.zh: 1964 年，他是伦敦肯辛顿同一所私立预备学校里被选中的三个男孩之一。
background.en: In 1964 he was one of three boys filmed at the same private pre-preparatory school in Kensington, London.

f28.zh: 拒绝参与 28 Up。SBS 称原因是他对参与这个系列心情复杂。
f28.en: Declined to take part in 28 Up; SBS attributes this to his mixed feelings about the series.

f35.zh: 回归，部分原因是为他的慈善机构 Friends of Bulgaria 做宣传。
f35.en: Returned, in part to promote his charity, Friends of Bulgaria.

f42.zh: 再次拒绝参与，49 Up 时回归。
f42.en: Declined again; he returned for 49 Up.

background.zh: 她出身富裕家庭，有保姆照顾；1964 年在伦敦一所私立女子学校里被拍摄。
background.en: She came from a well-off family and had a nanny; in 1964 she was filmed at a private girls' school in London.

f63.zh: 选择不参与 63 Up，片中只出现了她在前几部里的旧镜头。
f63.en: Chose not to take part in 63 Up; she appears only in footage from earlier films.

f70.zh: 在最后一部 70 Up 中回归。
f70.en: Returned for the final film, 70 Up.

background.zh: 1964 年，他在一所管教严格的私立寄宿学校读书。他的父亲是驻扎在当时南罗得西亚的军人，7 岁的他说最大的心愿是见到远在六千英里外的爸爸，长大想当传教士。
background.en: In 1964 he was at a strict private boarding school. His father was a soldier stationed in what was then Southern Rhodesia; at seven he said his heart's desire was to see his father, 6,000 miles away, and that he wanted to be a missionary.

background.zh: 1964 年，她是伦敦东区工人阶级街区同一所小学里被选中的三个女孩之一。
background.en: In 1964 she was one of three girls from the same primary school in a working-class area of London's East End.

background.zh: 1964 年，她是伦敦东区同一所小学里被选中的三个女孩之一。7 岁时她说将来打算去 Woolworths 百货店工作。
background.en: In 1964 she was one of three girls from the same primary school in London's East End. At seven she said she planned to work at Woolworths.

f63.zh: Lynn 于 2013 年因突发疾病去世，享年 57 岁，是系列中第一位去世的参与者。63 Up 里由她的丈夫 Russ 和两个女儿讲述她的离世。
f63.en: Lynn died in 2013, aged 57, after a sudden illness — the first participant to die. In 63 Up her husband Russ and their two daughters talk about her death.

f70.zh: 70 Up 里有对 Lynn 的怀念，她被深情地回忆为三个好朋友中的一员；据维基百科，Jackie 在片中谈到失去这位儿时好友。
f70.en: 70 Up remembers Lynn fondly as one of the trio of friends; according to Wikipedia, Jackie speaks about losing her childhood friend.

background.zh: 1964 年，她是伦敦东区同一所小学里被选中的三个女孩之一。
background.en: In 1964 she was one of three girls from the same primary school in London's East End.

background.zh: 伦敦东区的男孩，1964 年在一所公立小学读书，7 岁时就想当骑师。
background.en: An East End boy at a state primary school in 1964; at seven he wanted to be a jockey.

background.zh: 父母离婚后，他住进了米德尔塞克斯（Middlesex）的一家儿童之家，1964 年和同一家儿童之家的另一个男孩一起在那里被拍摄。
background.en: After his parents divorced, he lived in a children's home in Middlesex, where he was filmed in 1964 with another boy from the home.

background.zh: 1964 年，他住在一家儿童之家，父亲不在身边。他是系列中唯一的非白人孩子。
background.en: In 1964 he lived in a children's home, with his father absent from his life. He was the only non-white child in the series.

f35.zh: 未参与 35 Up，当时他正在办离婚。
f35.en: Did not take part in 35 Up; he was in the middle of a divorce at the time.

background.zh: 约克郡山谷（Yorkshire Dales）一户农家的儿子，家里在 Littondale 务农。1964 年，他是唯一一个来自约克郡乡村小村庄的男孩，在一所只有一间教室的小学校读书。
background.en: A farmer's son from the Yorkshire Dales; his family farmed in Littondale. In 1964 he was the only boy chosen from a small country village in Yorkshire, and went to a tiny one-room school.

f70.zh: Nick 于 2023 年 7 月 23 日去世，享年 65 岁。他身患绝症，主动联系制片人 Claire Lewis，希望录制最后一次访谈；访谈在他去世前不久拍摄，用在了 70 Up 里。
f70.en: Nick died on 23 July 2023, aged 65. Terminally ill, he contacted producer Claire Lewis wanting to record a final interview; it was filmed shortly before his death and is used in 70 Up.

background.zh: 1964 年，他是利物浦中产阶级郊区同一所小学里被选中的两个男孩之一。7 岁时他想当宇航员。
background.en: In 1964 he was one of two boys from the same primary school in a middle-class Liverpool suburb. At seven he wanted to be an astronaut.

f35.zh: 他在 28 Up 里批评撒切尔政府的政策，遭到媒体抨击，此后连续三部没有参与。
f35.en: After criticising Thatcher-era policies in 28 Up he faced a press backlash, and stayed out of the next three films.

f42.zh: 未参与（28 Up 引发媒体抨击后，他连续三部缺席）。
f42.en: Did not take part (the second of three films he missed after the press backlash over 28 Up).

f49.zh: 未参与（28 Up 引发媒体抨击后，他连续三部缺席）。
f49.en: Did not take part (the third of three films he missed after the press backlash over 28 Up).

f56.zh: 回归，条件是可以借此宣传他的乐队 The Good Intentions。
f56.en: Returned, on condition that he could promote his band, The Good Intentions.

background.zh: 1964 年，他是利物浦郊区同一所小学里被选中的两个男孩之一。7 岁时他想当宇航员或长途汽车司机。
background.en: In 1964 he was one of two boys from the same primary school in a Liverpool suburb. At seven he wanted to be an astronaut or a coach driver.
